mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.building_code AS buildingCode, b.road_address AS roadAddress, b.jibun_address AS jibunAddress, b.bld_nm AS bldNm, b.dong_nm AS dongNm, b.pnu, b.latitude, b.longitude FROM building b WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM infrastructure i WHERE i.building_id = b.id ) LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, building_code AS buildingCode, road_address AS roadAddress, jibun_address AS jibunAddress, bld_nm AS bldNm, dong_nm AS dongNm, pnu, latitude, longitude FROM building WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO infrastructure ( building_id, infra_category, count_within2000m, nearest_distance_meters, nearest_walk_minutes, is_saturated, computed_at ) VALUES ( #{buildingId}, #{infraCategory}, #{countWithin2000m}, #{nearestDistanceMeters}, #{nearestWalkMinutes}, #{isSaturated}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE count_within2000m = VALUES(count_within2000m), nearest_distance_meters = VALUES(nearest_distance_meters), nearest_walk_minutes = VALUES(nearest_walk_minutes), is_saturated = VALUES(is_saturated), computed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, building_id AS buildingId, infra_category AS infraCategory, count_within2000m AS countWithin2000m, nearest_distance_meters AS nearestDistanceMeters, nearest_walk_minutes AS nearestWalkMinutes, is_saturated AS isSaturated, computed_at AS computedAt FROM infrastructure WHERE building_id = #{buildingId} AND infra_category = #{infraCategory}

SELECT id, building_id AS buildingId, infra_category AS infraCategory, count_within2000m AS countWithin2000m, nearest_distance_meters AS nearestDistanceMeters, nearest_walk_minutes AS nearestWalkMinutes, is_saturated AS isSaturated, computed_at AS computedAt FROM infrastructure WHERE building_id = #{buildingId}

SELECT id, infra_id AS infraId, infra_name AS infraName, road_address AS roadAddress, latitude, longitude, distance_m AS distanceM, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM infrastructure_detail WHERE infra_id = #{infraId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
